name: Allegion plc
sector: Industrials / Security products — locks, access control & door hardware
moat_justification: Spec-driven security hardware leader (Schlage, Von Duprin, LCN) with trusted brands, code/specification placement in commercial buildings, installed-base and professional-channel stickiness, and proven pricing power. ROIC proxy stayed 19.5-27.1% over 2020-2025 and gross margin rose from 40.4% (2022) to 45.2% (2025) in fundamentals.json, supporting a moderate-strong moat. Capped at 6 because ASSA ABLOY is larger globally, mechanical hardware faces smart-lock/biometric substitution and tech entrants, and growth is tied to cyclical non-residential construction with only mid-single-digit organic guide.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.2%) vs bull-case tier C (11.7%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: High-quality security-hardware compounder, moat 6/10 — but at $156.54 it does not clear 15%: weighted IRR 9.8%, weighted IV@15 $86.79 vs $156.54, bear-to-bull tier D to C; clears 15% only below ~$86.79.
moat_for: Schlage / Von Duprin / LCN brands specified into commercial buildings — spec placement and code compliance create installed-base stickiness
ROIC proxy 19.5-27.1% through 2020-2025 and gross margin expanding to 45.2% in FY2025 (fundamentals.json) — pricing power proven, including 2026 price actions for inflation
Professional / institutional channel and trusted-brand position in North American commercial and premium residential locks
Electronic access control growth and recurring specification / replacement demand
moat_against: ASSA ABLOY is the larger global rival; Spectrum/Kwikset, dormakaba and smart-lock tech entrants contest every category
Smart locks, mobile credentials and biometrics can commoditize or bypass mechanical hardware
Demand tied to cyclical non-residential construction; International organic revenue fell 1.2% in Q2 2026 despite reported growth from acquisitions/FX
Organic growth guide is only 3.5-4.5% for FY2026 — reported growth leans on acquisitions, pricing and FX
